text: Why does your dog yawn when you yawn?
phonemes: wˌaɪ dˈʌz jʊɹ dˈɑːɡ jˈɔːn, wɛn jˈuː jˌɔːn?

text: Most people think it's just tired or stressed.
In one study, twenty-five dogs saw their owner yawn, and a stranger yawn.
asr: In one study, 25 dogs saw their owner yawn, and a stranger yawn.

text: They yawned more at their owner's yawns.
And they yawned less when the yawn was fake.
Their heart rate didn't change, so stress is unlikely.
Forty to sixty percent of adults catch yawns, and your dog's brain may be tuned to you.
asr: 40 to 60 percent of adults catch yawns, and your dog's brain may be tuned to you.

text: Your yawn is contagious, but mostly to the dog that knows you.
Try it tonight: yawn slowly, then save this and see if yours catches it.
Follow for why your dog does the next weird thing.
